title: Random Shelf
author: Thank_You
description:
This compact 3D-printed shelf is designed for quick and practical wall-mounted storage. It features a flat base with raised edges on three sides to keep items secure, and two mounting holes for easy installation. The front edge includes an embossed “Shelf” label for a clean, minimal look.

Perfect for organizing small tools, accessories, or decor in your workshop, kitchen, or office. Prints easily without supports and fits most FDM printers.

- No supports needed
- Mounting holes: 2 × 6mm
- Material: PLA recommended
